name: Harbor Steel & Supply Corporation
old_description: Serving our valued customers in Michigan, Southern Indiana, Ohio, Kentucky, and West Virginia with prime materials. We specialize in quality control, on-time delivery, and total satisfaction based customer service. Offering modern facilities and state of the art processing equipment, Harbor Steel and Supply can accommodate almost any requirement you may have.
about:
Harbor Steel & Supply Corporation, headquartered in Prichard, West Virginia, has operated as a family-owned metal service center since 1952. The company was founded on principles of quality, reliability, and long-term customer relationships.

The company functions as a full-service metal supplier and processor across six U.S. locations. Its processing capabilities include tube and sheet laser cutting, beam cutting, oxy-fuel plate burning, saw cutting, cold saw cutting, plasma cutting, shearing, forming, and grinding. The facilities handle hot-rolled, stainless, and aluminum materials in bar, beam, tube, pipe, plate, and structural shapes, serving over 6,000 active customers.

Harbor Steel serves the metal industry throughout Michigan, southern Indiana, Ohio, Kentucky, and West Virginia. Customers range from fabricators and manufacturers requiring precision-cut components to projects needing structural steel processing and material preparation.

The company emphasizes responsiveness, communication, and follow-through from quote to completion, supported by a customer portal for order tracking and a multi-location inventory that enables consistent delivery.
